name: @media-router/plugin-mpegts-core
description: Library plugin (no mediaRouter manifest — never appears in Add Module): MPEG-TS domain base code. C++ mrts packet core (PSI parse/build, TS splitter, H.264/H.265 SPS probe) plus the python reference modules that are its executable specification, the parity-test fixtures, the TS timeline shifter, and the TS-side PMT descriptor-loop reader every TS plugin walks ES descriptors with.

scripts.test:py: cd py && python3 ts_psi_test.py && python3 ts_split_test.py && python3 ts_video_info_test.py && python3 ts_timeline_test.py
